evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 41st Research Institute”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and CETC lists the institute among its member units. The US Commerce Department listed it in May 2024 for acquiring and attempting to acquire US-origin items to advance China’s quantum technology capabilities, citing the military applications of quantum technologies.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.
